nodes.label: ComLinked MVP Build Plan: Free Launch
nodes.rationale: The MVP is completely free and has one job: get a new company its first real lead within 24 hours, then give it a reason to come back every day. Any feature that does not help companies sign up, get leads, return daily, talk to other companies or share wins waits until after launch.

nodes.label: PCCI-Quezon City (pilot chamber)
nodes.rationale: Named as the pilot; soft launch with 30-50 companies, then all members after two weeks of fixes.

nodes.label: Free for everyone
nodes.rationale: Every feature is open to every company; interest signals show the company names behind them; nothing is blurred.

nodes.label: First lead in 24 hours
nodes.rationale: Each new company gets at least 3 relevant matches and one who's-interested signal on its first day; community managers make intros where the system can't yet.

nodes.label: A reason to return daily
nodes.rationale: Fresh leads, new interest signals and a visible rise in search ranking every morning.

nodes.label: Activity earns visibility
nodes.rationale: Companies that update their profile, reply, post asks and share wins rank higher in search results.

nodes.label: Success is shared
nodes.rationale: Every closed deal invites both sides to post a short testimonial that other companies see.

nodes.label: AI is optional (AI drafts, a person decides)
nodes.rationale: One switch turns the AI Assistant on or off; everything works manually too. With the switch off every screen works the same way with an empty message box and templates.

nodes.label: Company-owned relationships
nodes.rationale: Connections belong to the company, not the employee, so they stay when people leave.

nodes.label: Mobile first
nodes.rationale: A web app that works well on phones, since most owners in the pilot will use a phone; no app-store approval needed.

nodes.label: Daily lead loop
nodes.rationale: Every action today raises tomorrow's visibility: morning digest, act on today's leads, talk and close, share the win, rank rises; higher rank brings more views that fill the next morning's digest. Every MVP feature supports one step of this loop.

nodes.label: A1 Pre-built company profiles
nodes.rationale: AI builds draft profiles from each company's website, Facebook page or public directory listings before launch, so nobody starts from a blank form.

nodes.label: A2 Claim your profile
nodes.rationale: A personal link by email or SMS ('3 companies are already a match'), one tap to claim; turns the pre-built database into active users.

nodes.label: A3 Easy sign-in
nodes.rationale: Google, Facebook, email magic link or mobile one-time code; fewer drop-offs on phones.

nodes.label: A4 Profile strength meter
nodes.rationale: A 0-100% bar with the next single step; better profiles mean better matches and higher ranking.

nodes.label: A5 Invite your business partners
nodes.rationale: Invite customers and suppliers by link, email or chat; both companies get a ranking boost when they join; each user brings in more companies at no cost.

nodes.label: L1 Day-one matches
nodes.rationale: 3 matched companies right after claiming, each with a one-line 'why you should meet'; the first visit shows real value.

nodes.label: L2 ComDash interest signals
nodes.rationale: Who found you in search, viewed your profile, messaged you, or was recommended your company; company names are shown free. The 'someone is looking at me' moment that brings people back.

nodes.label: L3 Asks board
nodes.rationale: Post a need; matching companies are notified and can respond; creates leads both ways every day.

nodes.label: L4 Community manager intros
nodes.rationale: Pilot community managers hand-pick introductions and post asks for quiet members so no early adopter goes a week without a lead; effort tapers off as activity becomes self-sustaining.

nodes.label: D1 Morning digest
nodes.rationale: Push notification and email at 8:00 a.m. with new leads, profile views and rank change; the daily trigger to open the app.

nodes.label: D2 Daily lead list
nodes.rationale: 5 new matched companies each day with Connect, Message or Skip (Skip improves future matches); a short, finishable daily task.

nodes.label: D3 Activity Score and search rank
nodes.rationale: A visible score and 'your rank in [industry] searches' with what to do to climb; a clear reason to act daily.

nodes.label: D4 Freshness nudges
nodes.rationale: Prompts when a profile hasn't changed in 14 days; keeps profiles current.

nodes.label: D5 Monthly top companies
nodes.rationale: Chamber leaderboard of the 10 most active companies; recognition only, no prizes.

nodes.label: C1 Company connections
nodes.rationale: An authorized representative sends a connection request and the other company accepts; connections belong to the company, not the person. ComLinked's core idea.

nodes.label: C2 ComMail
nodes.rationale: Company-to-company messaging with ready-made templates (introduction, quote request, partnership); turns a lead into a conversation.

nodes.label: C3 AI Assistant switch
nodes.rationale: One per-company On/Off switch. Four jobs only: intro to a match, reply to a ComMail, follow-up after 3 days, polish words. Never sends on its own, switchable any time (recorded), starts on for new companies, uses only ComLinked information, drafts marked 'AI draft'. Saves time without taking away control.

nodes.label: C4 Outcome buttons
nodes.rationale: 'We met' and 'We did business', confirmed by both companies; proves results and triggers testimonials.

nodes.label: S1 Testimonial prompt
nodes.rationale: After both sides confirm 'We did business', each answers 2 questions; AI can polish wording if the Assistant is on. Real proof from real users.

nodes.label: S2 Success wall
nodes.rationale: Recent testimonials and deals on the home feed and both companies' profiles; shows newcomers that it works.

nodes.label: S3 One-tap share
nodes.rationale: Share a testimonial card to Facebook, LinkedIn or Viber with ComLinked branding and a sign-up link; free marketing that brings new companies in.

nodes.label: Chamber and community manager basics (3.6)
nodes.rationale: Member import (upload list, profiles built, claim links sent), activity view (who claimed, who is active, who needs an intro), intros and broadcasts, and an admin back office that is just the database dashboard; no custom admin console in the MVP.

nodes.label: Activity Score search ranking
nodes.rationale: search rank = relevance x (1 + Activity boost of up to 30%); relevance always comes first. Points over the last 30 days for actions (lead list 2, profile update 5, ComMail reply 3, ask 5, connection 5, meeting 10, deal 25, testimonial 15, invited company claims 10) with daily limits. Anti-gaming: meetings and deals count only when both confirm, daily limits stop spam, community managers review spikes. Every company gets the same 30-day new-member boost.

nodes.label: draft(task, context) server function
nodes.rationale: One on/off setting per company in the database; one server function with four short prompt templates (intro, reply, follow-up, polish); draft appears in the normal editable message box with the same Send button; daily per-company limit (e.g. 30 drafts) keeps AI costs predictable.

nodes.label: Anthropic API
nodes.rationale: Used for profile pre-building, match reasons and the four AI Assistant jobs.

nodes.label: Postponed until after the MVP
nodes.rationale: Features wait because they charge money or don't directly drive sign-ups, leads, daily use or shared wins; bring them back once the pilot shows companies returning on their own. Includes premium plans, cross-chamber add-on, chamber subscriptions, GPLI course bundle, full AI agent, native apps, prizes/badges, pipeline tracker, ROI reports, superuser console, multi-company accounts, other languages and SMS digest, events and news feed.

nodes.label: Full AI lead-generation agent (postponed to Phase 2)
nodes.rationale: Would find and qualify leads, talk to other companies' agents and book meetings (agent-to-agent talks, qualification scorecard, calendar booking). Postponed because it is complex; the simple Assistant comes first.

nodes.label: Premium plans, paywall blur, Stripe checkout (postponed)
nodes.rationale: No payments in the MVP; hiding names would block the first-lead moment. Earliest after the pilot shows daily use.

nodes.label: MVP tech stack (Next.js, Supabase Singapore, Vercel, Anthropic API, email + web push)
nodes.rationale: Stays on hosted services and drops Stripe since nothing is sold. Supabase in the Singapore region for the Philippine pilot (add a Canadian region before Toronto); Vercel for one-click deploys and preview links; transactional email plus web push for digest, claim links and nudges.

nodes.label: Build loop for every feature (7.1)
nodes.rationale: Ask Claude for one feature naming its Section 3 ID and review the plan first; test on the preview link as a new company owner on a phone; report what is wrong, retest, then commit.

nodes.label: Build order (7.2)
nodes.rationale: Features are built in the order that delivers a working lead experience soonest so testing can start with real members early: setup; A1; A2-A4; L2; C1-C2; C3; L1, D2; L3; D1, D4; D3, D5; C4, S1-S3; A5, L4, 3.6; privacy review, member import, soft launch. About 5-7 weeks of focused daily build sessions.

nodes.label: Pilot targets (first 90 days)
nodes.rationale: Pilot succeeds if companies get a lead on day one and keep returning within 90 days. Targets: 40% claim within 14 days, 90% with 3 matches and 1 signal on day one, 3+ days a week on lead list, 50% weekly active, 2+ ComMails a week, 60% AI still on after 30 days, 50% profiles fresh, 20 deals, 10/25 testimonials, 1 invite join per 5 active companies. Reset after the first month of real data.

nodes.label: Privacy and security review before real members join
nodes.rationale: Check the Philippine Data Privacy Act and National Privacy Commission requirements for the pilot, and Canadian privacy law before Toronto; sign-up must tell companies that profile views are visible to others.

hyperedges.label: Daily lead loop: digest, act, talk and close, share the win, rank rises
